name: my-plugins
description: zhiyinft's customized Claude Code plugins, mods and skills

plugins.name: fanyi
plugins.description: Write to Claude Code in your own language while Claude works in English, with streamed translations of every reply.

plugins.name: prompt-rail
plugins.description: A rail of your session's prompts beside the transcript or above the prompt; hover to read one, click to jump to it.

plugins.name: prismantis
plugins.description: Colorful, themeable rendering for Claude Code replies: tables, code, diagrams, charts and tool rows, with copy buttons.

plugins.name: qa-split
plugins.description: Your prompts and Claude's answers in the transcript; tool calls, notes and thinking in a Details pane beside it that follows your scrolling.
